# Hunch Board

> Hunch Board (hunchboard.dev) is one free board for planning a project, kept as a text file: board.hunch. Anything can go on it: boxes and arrows, UML, decisions, screens, checklists, images and other files.

- [Skill](SKILL.md): how to read and write a .hunch file
- [Example](examples/shop/board.hunch): a shop with a decision, a UML class, a checklist, a file and a board inside a box
- [CLI](hunch.mjs): one file, Node 20 or newer. `node hunch.mjs check --json`
- [Board](https://www.hunchboard.dev/board): opens right away, no account
- npm package name: hunch-board
